views.name: salesperson_annual_sales
views.body_sql: SELECT soh.salespersonid AS salesperson, strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate) AS year, SUM(soh.subtotal) AS total_sales FROM salesorderheader soh GROUP BY soh.salespersonid, strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate)
views.description: aggregates sales transactions to compute total revenue per salesperson per year

views.name: salesperson_annual_quotas
views.body_sql: SELECT BusinessEntityID AS salesperson, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS year, SUM(SalesQuota) AS annual_quota FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate)
views.description: aggregates quota records to compute the assigned sales target per salesperson per year
